title: SSEngine-GLM5.3-Flash: Pipeline-Parallel Prefill with Tiered Prefix Caching for Agentic Workloads
description: An open-source prefill engine for GLM-5.3-Flash on four B200 GPUs that combines pipeline parallelism, a prefix cache across HBM, DRAM and SSD, and a shortest-remaining-prefill-first scheduler.
coverAlt: SSEngine-GLM5.3-Flash combines pipeline parallelism, a tiered prefix cache and a shortest-remaining-prefill-first scheduler, and its highest throughput is 3.1x and 3.2x the highest of any baseline on AgentX and TraceLab
